description: Aggregate whale context for one coin (cohort-level, no individual wallets): per-exchange reserve changes (1d/7d), top-trader long/short positioning on Binance perps, and large on-chain transfers to/from exchange wallets above a USD threshold. The transfer feed covers ERC-20 tokens; for native assets (BTC, ETH) it substitutes market-wide USDT exchange flows as a dry-powder signal. Exchange withdrawals suggest accumulation; deposits suggest potential sell pressure. For specific whale wallets and their live positions use flow_whale_positions.

min_usd.description: Minimum transfer size in USD to count as a whale transfer. Defaults to 1000000.

name: flow_whale_context

reserves.description: Exchange reserve balances, in coin units (not USD); venues largest first, empty when the feed has none

net1dCoins.description: 1d reserve change summed across venues, coins; absent when there are no venues

net7dCoins.description: 7d reserve change summed across venues, coins; absent when there are no venues

topTraders.description: Binance perp top-trader long/short split in 4h snapshots, oldest first; empty when the feed is down

longPct.description: Share of top-trader positions that are long, percent

transfers.description: Large on-chain transfers to or from exchange wallets, from the exchange's perspective: a deposit is potential sell pressure, a withdrawal accumulation

largest.description: Up to 50 transfers, largest first; empty when none are tracked

proxyAsset.description: Set when the feed has no native series and the transfers are another asset's market-wide flows (USDT), a dry-powder proxy; absent for native transfers

title: Whale Flow Context
